title: Wall St rises on easing inflation concerns
text: Forex Wall St rises on easing inflation concerns NEW YORK, May 10 (Reuters) - Wall Street jumped on Thursday, and Apple Inc <AAPL.O > inched closer to a $1 trillion stock market value, as tepid inflation data eased worries of faster interest rate hikes this year. The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 196.75 points, or 0.8 percent, to 24,739.29, the S&P 500 gained 25.25 points, or 0.94 percent, to 2,723.04, and the Nasdaq Composite added 65.07 points, or 0.89 percent, to 7,404.98.
